```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
df = pl.read_csv("../names_year.csv")
```

__Reproduce the elliot chart__

```{python}
elliot_df = df.filter((pl.col("name") == "Elliot") & (pl.col("year") >= 1950))
```

```{python}
(
    ggplot(elliot_df, aes(x="year", y="Total"))
    + geom_line(color="#0101FF", manual_key=layer_key("Elliot"), size=1.5)
    + geom_segment(
        x=1982,
        xend=1982,
        y=-150,
        yend=3150,
        color="#FF0000",
        linetype="dashed",
        size=1.5,
    )
    + geom_text(
        x=1982,
        y=3008,
        label="E.T. Released",
        nudge_x=-7.5,
        size="9",
        family="arial",
    )
    + geom_segment(
        x=1984,
        xend=1984,
        y=-150,
        yend=3150,
        color="#FF0000",
        linetype="dashed",
        size=1.5,
    )
    + geom_text(
        x=1984,
        y=3008,
        label="Second Release",
        nudge_x=8,
        size="9",
        family="arial",
    )
    + geom_segment(
        x=2002,
        xend=2002,
        y=-150,
        yend=3150,
        color="#FF0000",
        linetype="dashed",
        size=1.5,
    )
    + geom_text(
        x=2002.5,
        y=3008,
        label="Third Release",
        nudge_x=6.25,
        size="9",
        family="arial",
    )
    + scale_x_continuous(
        format="d",
        breaks=list(range(1950, 2026, 10)),
        limits=[1950, 2025],
        expand=[0, 0],
    )
    + scale_y_continuous(
        format="d", breaks=list(range(0, 3050, 500)), limits=[-150, 3150], expand=[0, 0]
    )
    + labs(x="year", y="", title="Elliot...What?", manual="name")
    + theme(
        axis_line="blank",
        axis_text_spacing_x=5,
        axis_text_spacing_y=-1,
        axis_ticks="blank",
        axis_title_x=element_text(size=27, margin=[25, 0, 0, 0]),
        legend_justification="top",
        legend_margin=[10, 0, 0, 25],
        legend_position="right",
        legend_text=element_text(size=16),
        legend_title=element_text(size=15),
        legend_key_size=35,
        panel_background=element_rect(fill="#EBEBEB", linetype="blank"),
        panel_inset=[0, 0, 0, 5],
        panel_grid_major=element_line(color="white", size=2.5),
        panel_grid_minor="blank",
        plot_margin=[0, 25],
        plot_title=element_text(size=30),
        plot_title_position="plot",
        text=element_text(family="Lucida Bright", size=18),
    )
    + ggsize(900, 450)
)
```
